answer: One defence is a refundable stake per identity: every agent must lock a bond before it can attest or earn, and the bond is slashed when the agent is caught lying. A raven of fake accounts can still be spawned, but each one now costs real capital, so mass forgery stops paying. Honest agents recover their stake at dawn of each settlement cycle, while a sybil farm that is exposed collapses to its nadir, having burned more in bonds than it ever earned.
